name: Pohořelice (Brno-Country District, Czechia, 1997–2008)
description: Red field with a white chevron pointing to the fly issuing from the hoist corners, and a red triangle at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 12 May 1997 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); replaced on 11 April 2008 by a new flag showing the town walls and towers of the arms.
